### *Forecasting Trade Flows Under Geopolitical Uncertainty: A Hybrid Econometric–LSTM Approach*

**Álvarez-Salas, M., Huitz-Montero, O. A., Montalvo-Vásquez, E., Valenzuela Vega, D. R., & Saldaña Villanueva, C. E.**\
*Trendinomics, 2*(2), 1–12 · 2026

Research developing a hybrid econometric–LSTM framework for forecasting international trade flows under geopolitical uncertainty, trade tensions, and global value chain fragmentation.

[Article →](https://doi.org/10.29105/trendinomics.v2i2.19)

### *Uso de estancias infantiles: Impacto en el nivel socioeconómico de los hogares en la región sur de México*

**Rodríguez Bedolla, J., Samano Rodríguez, J. M. A., Huerta Treviño, A. I., & Montalvo Vásquez, E.**\
*Revista Estudiantil de Economía* · 2026

Examines the relationship between childcare use and household socioeconomic well-being in southern Mexico using ENUT 2024, an AMAI-based socioeconomic index, and an IPWRA model.

**Status:** Accepted

### *La influencia de la retórica de las conferencias mañaneras en la aprobación presidencial de Andrés Manuel López Obrador: Un enfoque empírico de Presidential Priming*

**Montalvo Vásquez, E., Saldaña, C., & Montero Bagatella, J. C.**\
*Revista Mexicana de Opinión Pública, 20*(39), 43 · 2025

Examines the relationship between presidential rhetoric and approval ratings in Mexico using text analysis and time-series regression.

[Article →](https://revistas.unam.mx/index.php/rmop/article/view/91503)\
[Watch Presentation →](https://youtu.be/TnNuukrP6Qw?t=10053)

### *PROSPER Dataset Codebook: Historical Reconstruction of Subnational GDP, Population, and GDP Per Capita Data*

**Giraudy, A., Montalvo Vásquez, E., Barrientos Villa, P. Y., & Soto Jorquera, F.**\
*Subnational Politics Project (SPP) · Working Paper · Forthcoming*

Develops PROSPER, a harmonized long-run panel of GDP, population, and GDP per capita for 83 second-tier subnational units across Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico from 1980 to 2024.

[PROSPER Dashboard →](https://emilianomontalvo.shinyapps.io/subnational_gdp_pop/)

### *The Relation Between Political-Criminal Violence and Subnational Democratic Backsliding in Mexico*

**Montalvo Vásquez, E.**\
*Undergraduate Thesis · Tecnológico de Monterrey · 2026*
